title: Scarab God on Pile of Dung
description: A surreal black and white illustration of a multi-armed scarab beetle deity with a halo, sitting atop a large mound of dung and smaller beetles. The beetle holds circular objects in each hand while a ring of worshiping smaller beetles encircles the base, all surrounded by a vibrant border of multicolored dots and swirling golden lines.
prompt: Surreal black and white ink drawing of a six-armed scarab beetle god with round glasses and a glowing halo, seated on a massive pile of dung and smaller beetles. Smaller scarab beetles stand in a circle around the base with arms raised in worship. Colorful dots and swirling golden smoke frame the scene against a light background, intricate linework, detailed illustration.
medium: ink and mixed media on paper
